_description: Studi e attività professionali (Confprofessioni, CNEL H442) level 3, October 2026 regular run, permanent, full time: the minimo of the third tranche (1 October 2025).
_notes: Minimo level 3: 1,661.37 from 1 October 2024, 1,706.37 from 1 October 2025 (+45.00), 1,726.37 from 1 December 2026 (CCNL 16 February 2024, Art. 140, third and fourth tranche).
Level 3 carries no Elemento nazionale di allineamento contrattuale (only levels 1, 2 and 3S, and only for workers hired before 1 July 2004).
Base salary only: seniority increments, superminimi and the gross depend on facts outside the national table.

source.document: CCNL per i dipendenti degli studi e delle attività professionali, 16 febbraio 2024 (testo integrale definitivo, Confprofessioni)
source.section: Art. 140 - Minimi tabellari, terza tranche di aumento, row 3°
